aheadSummary: Eight items, all from the Pathfinder events page: Master Guide Summit (2-4 Apr), NAD PBE (23-24 Apr), Pathfinder Fair (21-23 May), the Master Guide cohort (3 dates, May-Jul), camp-meeting Pathfinder classes (19-22 Jul) and parade (24 Jul), and Pathfinder Leadership (13-15 Aug). These Pathfinder items also show that Soquel Camp Meeting 2027 includes 19-24 Jul, but its full dates are not published.
